title: Enterprise Connectivity: source evidence reviews
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs source evidence reviews for accountant review.

## Policy clause 1
The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

## Policy clause 2
A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record.

## Policy clause 3
Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows.

## Policy clause 4
Record corrected net service subtotal and tax component for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage credit rules.

## Policy clause 5
A rejected review cannot authorize money movement.

## Policy clause 6
The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision.

## Policy clause 7
Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through related-review reference.

## Policy clause 8
Review alone books no money.

## Evidence condition 1
For accountant review, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, source-event reference, related-review reference, contract identifier. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier, source-event reference, related-review reference, contract identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Points of judgement
Review alone books no money.

## Record identity: accountant review
A service specialist records the authoritative decision and corrected basis for one source object. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, source classification.
